source_evidence: Only exact UTF-8 ranges from controller-verified current artifact bytes; static observations are hypotheses, not fault proof.
worker_repeat_identity: Current failed observations, selected task/read/write scope, relevant artifact revisions and exact new source observations. Exclude attempt IDs, timestamps, wording and model/effort changes.
no_progress: Collect new relevant public source evidence before owner inference, profile selection or worker redispatch; identical evidence cannot release the gate.
input_rebuild: A changed serialized request, preserved choice schema and a coverage proof are required; the transport gate independently verifies the actual request and settled prior request.
uncertain: Stop at reconcile_request. Do not invoke the recovery callback or submit another request.
verification: Verification environment failures request restored evidence; they never nominate a product owner. Every repair still reruns all public checks.
historical: History is separate evidence, activated only by exact source/catalog, current relevant revision and failed-observation binding. It is not a current-run repair attempt.
completion: Public success requires an independent verifier outside this executor. Independent hidden details never enter model input.
